OVERVIEW

This redesign wasn't about fixing flows. It was about emotion: bringing back the magic of movie posters, the anticipation of a dark theater, the feeling that film is worth savoring.

Bring the emotion and nostalgia of cinema into the app's visual language

Lean into warmth, texture, and drama over clean, generic UI conventions

Celebrate the art of the movie poster — a dying medium worth reviving

Explore what it feels like when a film app actually feels like film
